topic.title: Neighbourhood Planning / Examination / Referendum / Made Plans
topic.source_contract: neighbourhood area and forum, evidence base, basic conditions, consultation, submission, independent examination, referendum, making, development-plan status, implementation, monitoring and review evidence

scope_guards: A designated neighbourhood area is not treated as an adopted neighbourhood plan.
A draft plan is not treated as having passed independent examination.
An examiner recommendation is not treated as a successful referendum.
A successful referendum is not treated as evidence that every policy is deliverable.
A made plan is not treated as planning permission for a site.
A CIL spending proposal is not treated as secured infrastructure delivery.
Developer engagement is not treated as an executed development agreement.
No score or promotion is written without exact plan status, site policy, consent, delivery and monitoring evidence.
